decks.notes: This deck focuses on quick aggression with powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Emperor of Bones. It utilizes various flicker effects such as Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to repeatedly generate value from entering the battlefield effects. The deck also includes disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the tempo of the game. Overall, the strategy revolves around utilizing blink effects to outvalue the opponent while applying pressure with aggressive threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of countermagic and disruptive spells to control the game, while also incorporating the combo of Shape Anew and Lórien Revealed to potentially bring out powerful creatures like Murktide Regent. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student allows for card advantage and filtering, while Prismari Command provides versatility. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and seize control of the board, using spells like Force of Negation, Spell Snare, and Deduce to counter threats. The mana base includes fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to quickly bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand onto the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to cycle through the deck and find key combo pieces. The deck's strategy revolves around combining powerful creatures with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the game while setting up game-winning combos. The inclusion of cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Psychic Frog allows for additional synergy and flexibility in gameplay.

This mono black aggro deck focuses on disruption and efficient creatures to take control of the game quickly. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's strategy, combined with powerful threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Emperor of Bones, the deck aims to apply pressure and close out games swiftly. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga provides additional card advantage and synergy with the deck's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overpower opponents with a mix of disruption and aggressive threats.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with artifact creatures and utilizing Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to draw cards and control the opponent's hand. It includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, alongside artifact ramp like Mox Opal and Mox Amber. Key to the Side-Door provides additional card advantage and mana ramp, while Urza's Saga helps to tutor for important artifacts. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans and controlling the game through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, and removal spells. It also utilizes creatures with disruptive abilities and card advantage engines to outvalue the opponent. The key strategy is to maintain control of the board and gradually grind out a win by outpacing the opponent's resources and denying them key plays. The deck excels at making the opponent's spells ineffective and capitalizing on any missteps they make.

This deck focuses on aggressively utilizing discard effects and cheap creatures to quickly fill the board with powerful threats like Hollow One and Vengevine. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and maintain board presence with recurring creatures like Detective's Phoenix. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt for additional reach and removal. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy and ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for the deck.

This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature tactics combined with control effects to pressure the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The goal is to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls while using cards like Quantum Riddler and Ocelot Pride to protect them. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah helps buff the team and close out games, while creatures like Solitude provide removal options. The deck also includes some recursion with cards like Ephemerate and Starfield Shepherd to maintain board presence and pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using various combo pieces and toolbox cards. By utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Finale of Devastation, the deck can find the necessary creatures to create powerful synergies and overwhelming board presence. With a mix of ramp, tutoring, and recursion elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a versatile and resilient creature-based strategy that can adapt to various situations and opponents.

The key strategy of this deck is to quickly deploy threats to pressure the opponent and control the board with removal and protection spells. By combining aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride with powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck aims to close out games swiftly. Additionally, the use of cards like Solitude and Quantum Riddler provides flexibility in dealing with opposing threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for the easy casting of all spells in the deck.

This deck combines aggressive creatures with flicker effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities. By blinking creatures like Flickerwisp and Witch Enchanter, you can disrupt your opponent's strategy and generate value from cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional disruption, while cards like Ephemerate and Solitude offer protection and removal. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its diverse color requirements, ensuring a smooth and consistent gameplay experience.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play with cards like Unearth and Persist, creating a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures. Key components include efficient discard spells like Thoughtseize, efficient removal like Fatal Push, and card draw effects like Thought Scour to help set up the combo. The deck also includes protection in the form of counterspells like Spell Pierce and versatile lands like Watery Grave to support the strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play at the right time using Green Sun's Zenith and Nature's Rhythm. Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies combo allows for infinite mana, which can be used to play Walking Ballista for the win. Leyline of Abundance and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler provide additional mana generation and creature buffs. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while controlling the board with versatile creatures like Badgermole Cub and Delighted Halfling.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly bring out creatures onto the battlefield and apply pressure to the opponent. This is achieved through cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Seasoned Pyromancer, and Voice of Victory. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats from the opponent. The goal is to swarm the board with creatures and use cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to push through damage and win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on using various ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to quickly accelerate mana and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. It utilizes control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions. The deck aims to quickly ramp into its big Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog, overwhelming the opponent with their powerful abilities. It also includes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Malevolent Rumble to help control the game and maintain board presence. The strategy involves efficiently ramping into big threats and controlling the board to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Gemstone Caverns and Gemstone Mine, while utilizing Cosmogoyf as a powerful win condition. The deck includes various cards to protect the combo, such as Pact of Negation and Chancellor of the Annex. It also includes cards like Plunge into Darkness to search for key pieces and cards like Spoils of the Vault to dig for combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and either overwhelm the opponent with Cosmogoyf or use cards like Thud to finish the game in one explosive turn.
